words.gloss: within the limits of the earth

literal: Within the limits of the earth, if enduring fame is achieved, the wise ones it will not praise, the world of gods.
translation: If a person achieves enduring fame within the limits of this earth, the celestial world of gods will praise them rather than its own wise sages.
modern: இந்த நிலவுலகில் ஒருவன் நிலைத்த புகழைப் பெற்றால், தேவர் உலகம் தன் அறிஞர்களைப் போற்றாமல் அந்தப் புகழுடையவனையே போற்றும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of earthly fame. If a person earns lasting fame within the boundaries of this world, their greatness is recognized even in the heavens. The celestial world of gods will cease praising its own wise sages and instead celebrate the famous mortal. The word 'pulavar' here refers to the wise ones or sages of the heavenly realm, emphasizing that earthly fame outshines even celestial wisdom.
